DemandRequirementSupport.description:
An assessment of one exact, packet-supplied demand requirement.

Requirement identities are assigned from frozen structured demand bytes.
They are not model-generated labels and are deliberately separate from
proposition labels, so an assessor cannot silently replace a demanded
referent, relation, evidence standard, time obligation, or prohibited
inference with a neighbouring claim.
DemandRequirementSupport.title: DemandRequirementSupport

EvidencePropositionSupport.description:
Mechanical account of a model's cited proposition assertion.

``scope_basis`` records the model's reading of the cited material.  It is
not a machine-proof of semantic entailment: source family/role and the
source-native locator are supplied separately in the execution packet,
while semantic entailment remains available for adjudication.  The
validator therefore checks citations, exact frozen identity, scope/time
completeness, and conclusion admissibility without pretending that a
categorical model label can interpret source prose.
EvidencePropositionSupport.title: EvidencePropositionSupport
